name: Deftblade Elite
oracle_text:
Provoke (Whenever this creature attacks, you may have target creature defending player controls untap and block it if able.)
{1}{W}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature this turn.
blocked_sentences: {1}{W}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only: true` option on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (and its PermanentShield), so a resolving ability can prevent only COMBAT damage dealt to and/or by a permanent for this turn, leaving burn, fight and other noncombat damage untouched
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` takes `dealt: to_and_by` and `duration: this_turn` but has no combat-only filter, so it would also stop noncombat damage (a strictly different card); the `prevent_damage` static has `combat_only` but is continuous while its source stands (no 'this turn', cannot be installed by an activated ability) and only stops damage dealt TO what it matches, never damage the creature deals; the one-shot `grant_ability` op cannot grant a static
